name: Path Tracing Engine (Radiance iOS Chapter 2.2/2.3)
description: Live path tracing from the real Minecraft world: ingests chunk meshes + vertex-color/UV albedo into Metal acceleration structures (2.1 sealed contract), renders progressively accumulated frames (sun direct + shadow rays + diffuse bounces) and composites them onto the game framebuffer via a Window.swapBuffers mixin + GL blit (2.3), with atlas-textured albedo read back from GL. v0.5.1: event-driven ingestion (BuiltChunk.setData mixin + resident ingest thread + 2s sentry fallback). v0.5.2 PACE: playability round — spp/frame clamped to 1 while the camera moves (the early-boost window re-armed on every move = 4-8x ray budget burned at 1-2 FPS on M3), dynamic resolution rungs steered by a frame-time EMA (720 top rung down to 0.31x), ingestion yields to the live renderer when frames exceed budget, and presentation is non-blocking with a snapshot serial (the render thread no longer waits for RT frames). Radiance iOS port, chapter 2 stage 2.4.
